title: Alignment Fabric for Company OKRs: Initiative Ownership, Release Gates, and Risk Signals
creator: Asha Raman
description:
Problem: As we scale Redwood’s product lines (Hosted API, Dedicated, Private), cross-functional initiatives are drifting out of sync with company-level OKRs. Teams are shipping features without explicit release gates tied to OKR impact, and there is no common signal set for early warning (cost regressions, latency/backpressure, model quality drop). This results in rework, misaligned prioritization, and customer incidents for high-impact flows.

Goal: Deliver a lightweight, repeatable ‘alignment fabric’ that ensures every company-level initiative has (1) a clear owner and success metrics mapped to an OKR; (2) a documented release gate checklist enforced at rollout; and (3) a set of risk signals surfaced in the Console so PM/Eng/Design/GTM can triage before customer impact. The fabric must be minimally bureaucratic and support both Hosted and Dedicated/Private release paths.

Scope and out-of-scope:
- In scope: initiative contract template; release gate checklist and gating decision workflow; risk signal definition (cost per token, tail latency P95/P99, model quality regression via evaluation job, deployment capacity saturation); dashboard prototype in Console; sync cadence and escalation path; onboarding doc and one pilot initiative.
- Out of scope: full automation of gating (we will integrate manual approvals + console flags in this phase) and org-wide training beyond pilot teams.

Deliverables:
- Initiative Contract template (Confluence) with OKR mapping, owner, success metrics, canary plan, rollback criteria.
- Release Gate checklist (GitHub PR template + Console gating flag).
- Risk Signal spec and Console dashboard prototype (links below).
- Pilot run with Billing & Dedicated Capacity team; retro write-up and next-phase recommendations.

Why now: Q2 commitments require tighter coordination between roadmap and operational controls to meet latency and cost SLOs while rolling out Dedicated capacity improvements and the new caching runtime features.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Initiative Contract template is reviewed and signed off by PM, Eng manager, and Design lead for the pilot initiative; 2) Release Gate checklist is present in the pilot repo and used in at least one PR; 3) Console prototype surfaces defined risk signals and raises an automated alert to the pilot Slack channel when thresholds are hit; 4) Pilot initiative shows no post-release customer severity > P2 attributable to alignment failures; 5) Playbook and onboarding doc published in Confluence; 6) Rollout plan to expand fabric to two additional initiatives is approved by Director of Product.
